title: Posthell
description: Social media scheduler for AI agents: draft posts into a human-approved queue for 15 networks.
summary: Social media scheduler for AI agents: draft posts into a human-approved queue for 15 networks.
offersHint: Social media scheduler for AI agents: draft posts into a human-approved queue for 15 networks. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.posthell.com/api/mcp · Requires headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using a posthell API key, e.g. 'Bearer ph_...'. Create one in the posthell dashboard's Agents tab (https://www.posthell.com/dashboard).

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Bearer token using a posthell API key, e.g. 'Bearer ph_...'. Create one in the posthell dashboard's Agents tab (https://www.posthell.com/dashboard).

toolsPreview.name: shape_post
toolsPreview.description: Turn rough notes about what the user did (shipped a feature, fixed a bug, hit a number) into 2-3 finished social-post angles in the user's voice. Grounded only in the notes - never invents facts. Uses one AI generation from the user's monthly quota.

toolsPreview.name: create_draft
toolsPreview.description: Save a post as a DRAFT in the user's posthell queue. It is never published by this tool - the user approves it in the dashboard. Optionally propose a publish time (pre-fills their scheduler) and limit which platforms it targets (default: every connected account).

toolsPreview.name: list_posts
toolsPreview.description: Read the user's recent posts and drafts with per-platform status. Published posts include engagement metrics (likes, comments, shares, engagementRate - impressions on plans with full analytics) once analytics have synced. Use it to avoid duplicating a topic AND to learn which topics performed before drafting the next post.

toolsPreview.name: get_growth
toolsPreview.description: The user's follower counts and 7-day growth per connected network, plus which network is growing fastest. Use this to decide where a post matters most or to report progress.
